description: Render a 1200x630 PNG Open Graph / social-card image from a template and return its public URL (for og:image and twitter:image tags), size and ready-to-paste meta tags. Templates: blog, launch, docs, minimal, gradient. Optional inline PNG with include_image. Same engine, cache and free-tier limits as GET /api/og. Read-only (renders are cached; nothing is stored about you).

author.description: Author or byline. Max 60 characters (longer text is truncated with "…").

include_image.description: Also return the PNG inline as MCP image content (default false; usually 30-150 KB).

label.description: Small pill or tag, e.g. "Engineering". Max 40 characters (longer text is truncated with "…").

logo.description: Public https:// URL of a PNG, JPEG or SVG logo (max 512 characters, 300 KB). Fetched by OgForge's server.

site.description: Site or brand name, e.g. "example.dev". Max 60 characters (longer text is truncated with "…").

subtitle.description: Secondary line / description. Max 200 characters (longer text is truncated with "…").

theme.description: Color scheme (default depends on the template).

title.description: Headline, e.g. "How we cut API latency by 60%". Max 120 characters (longer text is truncated with "…").

name: create_og_image

image_url.description: Public PNG URL (GET /api/og?...). Use it as og:image / twitter:image.

truncated.description: Fields that were shortened to fit.

warning.description: e.g. logo_fetch_failed: the image rendered without the logo.

title: Create an Open Graph social preview image
